heroTitle: A premium med spa website built to turn local traffic into booked consultations.
heroSubtitle: A polished, conversion-first preview for injectables, facials, IV therapy, body treatments, and membership offers.

sections.title: Make the online experience match the quality of the treatments.
sections.body: Most med spa websites look generic. This direction builds trust quickly with clear service pathways, before-and-after proof blocks, treatment education, and booking CTAs that keep visitors moving.

sections.title: Turn the homepage into a booking path, not a brochure.
sections.body: The structure guides visitors from treatment interest to consultation. High-intent actions stay visible: book a consult, view treatment menus, explore specials, or message the team.

sections.title: Built for SEO, ads, content, and monthly campaigns.
sections.body: The site can support local SEO pages, Meta ads, landing pages, seasonal offers, content bundles, and review-building campaigns once the foundation is live.

testimonial: Your services are already premium. The website should make people feel that before they ever walk through the door.
